labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. On Saturday I went to my sister's house because it was her birthday. We had a huge cake, so I was very full. I was really happy to see her. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. A party. I went to a party. Therapist. A party. Whose party was it? Child. Hana's. It was her birthday. Therapist. Hana's birthday. Who else was there? Child. Lots of people. From my class. Therapist. Lots of people from your class. Where was the party? Child. At the soft play. Therapist. At the soft play. What happened there? Child. We went on the big slide. Then pizza. Therapist. The big slide and then pizza. What else happened? Child. Hana opened presents. I gave her a unicorn. Therapist. You gave her a unicorn. How did you feel at the party? Child. Excited. Therapist. Really excited. You sound like you were thrilled. What happened at the end of the party? Child. Can I tell you about the slide? Therapist. Okay, tell me about the slide. Child. It was really fast. I went down ten times. Therapist. Ten times. And how did the party finish? Child. Don't know. Therapist. That's okay. Let me say your story back to you. You went to Hana's birthday party at the soft play with lots of people from your class. You went on the big slide and had pizza, and you gave Hana a unicorn. You felt really excited. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
